decisions.executionNote: Begin a gradual elbow-up left approach to the pink bottle; right remains clear. Bottle depth and tool offset will be refined visually.
Advance the open left jaws toward the pink bottle body, preserving the current wrist orientation and elbow-up branch.
Refine pink-bottle alignment with a short forward/right and downward approach; keep jaws open until centered.
Close the left jaws around the pink bottle and make a short vertical test lift; verify retention in the next RGB.
Pink bottle appears retained; lift and translate left toward the bin while keeping the grasp closed.
Carry the retained pink bottle fully over the left bin before releasing.
Open the left gripper over the bin. Begin a gradual right-arm approach toward the yellow bottle without crossing the midline.
Bring the right jaws closer to the yellow bottle. Reposition the empty left hand toward a safe receiving stance.
Replan from the interrupted pose with smaller right increments and more forward clearance; continue left receiving preparation.
The yellow bottle tipped toward the center. Clear the right hand and prepare a left top-down grasp of its now-horizontal body.
Orient left jaws downward across the horizontal yellow bottle, staying on the left side of the midline; right holds clear.
Lower and center the left jaws around the yellow bottle body, then close without translating.
Test-lift the closed left grasp and begin clearing the yellow bottle to the left.
The yellow bottle did not lift. Reopen and approach its body lower, correcting the estimated link-to-jaw offset.
Seat the jaws slightly lower around the yellow body, close, and make a small retention test.
Lift the newly closed yellow-bottle grasp clear of the table and toward the left, checking retention.
Yellow bottle is visibly retained. Carry left with clearance while gradually turning the wrist toward the bin.
Continue carrying the yellow bottle toward the bin, smoothly restoring a more upright wrist configuration.
Position yellow fully above the bin. In parallel, turn and advance the right hand toward the upright white bottle.
Release yellow over the bin and align the open right jaws with the white bottle, avoiding the lower lying bottle.
Refine right-hand alignment on the white bottle and move the empty left arm back toward a receiving position.
Center the right jaws laterally on the white bottle and close; continue preparing the left hand to receive it.
Test the right grasp with a vertical lift before attempting the handover.
White bottle was not retained and is now lying down. Reopen and move the right hand above it for a downward grasp.
Replan from the interrupted right pose with half-sized increments, keeping the elbow-up branch and clearing the bottle.
Rotate the right jaws downward above the white bottle, compensating forward to keep the approach centered.
Descend toward the white bottle body with open jaws, correcting the lateral offset and refining the downward approach.
Seat the right jaws lower around the white bottle, close and begin a small lift to check retention.
Lift the white bottle clear with the right grasp closed; confirm it follows before beginning the handover.
White bottle follows the right grasp. Lift and turn it toward the center while aligning the open left hand for handover.
Bring the retained white bottle to the central handover zone, neck toward the open left hand; keep both wrists on their own sides.
Align the left open jaws with the exposed lower section of the white bottle while the right maintains its grasp above and to the right.
Seat and close the left jaws on the exposed white-bottle neck while the right hand stays fixed and closed.
Release the right grasp for handover, then separate the hands slowly and test retention in the closed left gripper.
White is retained by the left hand after handover. Carry it toward the bin while the right repositions above the remaining bottle.
No motion executed in the rejected chunk. Reduce right-arm increments and retain the same leftward carrying plan.
Carry white farther over the left bin while positioning the right open jaws above the remaining pale bottle.
Release the handed-over white bottle inside the bin; lower the right open jaws toward the remaining bottle body.
Close the right grasp after seating the jaws around the remaining bottle; withdraw the open left hand from the released white bottle.
Test-lift the last bottle in the closed right grasp while bringing the left hand into a receiving stance.
Carry the final bottle toward the center at handover height, presenting its exposed base toward the open left jaws.
Bring the bottle base into the open left grasp, lowering the receiver to the visible bottle height while keeping the right grip closed.
Advance the left jaws onto the exposed bottle base and close while the right hand continues supporting it.
Release the right grip and gently separate the hands to test the final bottle's retention in the left hand.
Carry the final bottle leftward in the closed grasp and retract the empty right hand with gradual orientation recovery.
Final bottle is visibly retained by the left hand. Carry it toward the bin while gradually returning the empty right arm.
Place the entire final bottle over the bin opening before releasing; continue the right arm's smooth return.
Release the last bottle over the bin, then begin withdrawing the open left gripper while both arms return toward origin.
